gates.allgroup_validation_gain: selected improves EVERY validation group by >=0.1pp
gates.monotone_train: every accepted step improves every training group

scope: Local optimizer diagnostic, existing validation selection only. Training monotonicity is algorithm audit, not generalization. No convergence/global optimum claim on budget stop. No fresh or intact eval.
design: Start frozen H300 refined64. Full18 unit-gradient min-norm common descent, require negative derivatives and Armijo improvement of every training group. Eight iterations; descending fixed grid. Select max minimum validation gain over18 groups vs starting basis, including step0.

comparison_gates.rank_gain: rank64 selected validation fidelity exceeds rank32 selected by >=5pp in BOTH families
comparison_gates.optimization_gain: rank64 selected improves its own proxy by >=2pp in BOTH families
comparison_gates.compact80: rank64 selected fidelity>=80% in BOTH families
